grammar.title: Approximately with 大约
grammar.explanation: 大约 (dàyuē) means "approximately, about" — used before a number or time to show it's an estimate, not exact. It's similar to 大概 but a little more common right before precise numbers.

sentences.zh: 这次会议大约需要两个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì dàyuē xūyào liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.en: This meeting will take about two hours.

sentences.zh: 大约有一百人参加了这次比赛。
sentences.pinyin: Dàyuē yǒu yī bǎi rén cānjiā le zhè cì bǐsài.
sentences.en: About a hundred people took part in this competition.

sentences.pinyin: Tā dàyuē qī diǎn huì dào.
